title: feat(state): read carries the referenced records, and the MCP text renders the state of record
context:
A second agent reading a served partition got only ids and hashes back and went looking
for the summary text on disk. ReadResponse now carries `records` (by id, exactly the
records behind the refs in state_of_record; additive, absent without a subject), and
nuryel_read's text renders them: current derived content, commitments with due and owner,
receipts with action, target and verification state. Found on the live claim-3 run.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
 Touches invariant(s): con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex); con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Introduced code in src/core, src/mcp, src/store, test/mcp-state.test.ts, test/state-binding.test.ts (5 file(s)).
